decisions.reason: As a niche men's care line launched in 2019, it has had enough time to reveal demand, and with limited visible follow-up the option value of waiting now looks lower than the cost of keeping a likely weak portfolio item alive.

As a cleansing foam added to an existing facial care series, it fits the firm's core natural skincare range and likely remains a useful, lower-risk option to retain because it complements established products and channels.
